svg.title: How dictation works
svg.desc: Hold a key in any app and talk. Parakeet decodes the whole passage on the Neural Engine, a deterministic text pass cleans it, the app in front decides how much to rewrite, and the text is pasted at the cursor.
svg.text: Hold a key, talk, let go.
The text lands where the cursor is.
One passage, from key down to pasted text. On a 20 to 30 second passage the decode takes about 0.15 s.
the app in front and the
text before the caret are read
What the app in front decides
Terminals and editors get the words verbatim; most apps get the clean text.
Chat and mail can get a smart pass: Gemma rewrites for the app and its tone,
and the result is kept only if it is clearly the same passage.
Password fields are never read and always verbatim.
Names that recur in your library feed the spellings,
and each new one is offered as a one-tap chip.
